memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: For a foreign self-employed person working on-site in Belgium, the Limosa declaration must be done before the first working day and the client should ask for the L1 receipt; if work starts without it, the client can get into trouble as well.

suggested.title: Limosa and L1 before first working day

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: There are three things to look at. First, the Lima so declaration — it has to be done before the first working day, and you, as the client, should ask for the L1 receipt.

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: If he starts without it, the client can get into trouble too, not only him.

quote.text: Yes, exactly — we had the same with a German freelancer in spring, I checked it on the Limosa portal then.

memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: A Dutch self-employed person working in Belgium must request an A1 certificate from the Dutch social security office showing they remain insured in the Netherlands; without an A1 there is a risk of paying social security contributions in both countries. It can take a few weeks, so it should be obtained before the first working day.

suggested.title: A1 certificate before starting in Belgium

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Second, the a one certificate. He requests it from the Dutch social security office, and it shows that he stays insured in the Netherlands.

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Without the a one, there is a risk that he has to pay contributions in both countries.

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: No. So ask him for it early, it can take a few weeks.

memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: When a client requires a freelancer to work fixed hours or to report to the team daily, the arrangement creates a risk of schijnzelfstandigheid (bogus self-employment).

suggested.title: Fixed hours and bogus self-employment risk

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Ok, that's an important point. That sounds more like an employee than a freelancer — that's the schijn zelf standig heid risk, bogus self-employment.

memes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
memes.statement: Whenever a client sets fixed hours or gives instructions to a freelancer, the case must be flagged to a Senior Expert before the contract is signed.

suggested.title: Flag fixed-hour freelancer cases to Senior Expert

quotes.speaker: senior.expert@sdworx.example
quotes.text: Internally, our rule is: whenever a client sets fixed hours or gives instructions to a freelancer, the case is flagged to a Senior Expert before the contract is signed.
